# Find the player position and try clicking it
seg = current_frame.segmentation
# Player is likely the small yellow/blue object
player = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['Y', 'b'] and 5 < n['pixels'] < 30:
        player = n
        break

if player:
    b = player['boundary']
    minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
    maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
    minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
    maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_r = (minr + maxr) // 2
    center_c = (minc + maxc) // 2
    print(f"Player at ({center_r}, {center_c}), color={player['color']}, pixels={player['pixels']}")
    
    # Try clicking the player
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
    
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    greens2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"\nAfter clicking player:")
    print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens2)}")
    print(f"gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
    print(f"level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
else:
    print("Player not found, listing small objects:")
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] < 30:
            b = n['boundary']
            minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
            minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
            print(f"  Color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, at ({minr}, {minc})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
